## Session Brief

* [T-F1: build the peripheral spine without a single-leg pT cut](T-F1.md) - Separate the pole floor (always on, from a fixed default scale) from the support bound (only from a provable pT floor), build the spine for every final state, and measure bias and variance before any σ gate.
* [T-F2: the γγ → ℓℓ corner and the default pole scale](T-F2.md) - Find why DY's overweight tail sits at the 10 GeV² pole floor (γγ → ℓℓ with both photon rungs near it), fix the channel or the floor, keep every bias check, and re-measure DY's budget climb.
* [T-V1: version bump, then is the CMS VBF σ well defined?](T-V1.md) - Bump the artifact version for the new channel maps; re-run mutation M1; then measure whether the three CMS cards' σ is regulated (ptj = 0, etaj = -1) on both vibegraph's and MadGraph's side, before any ladder.
* [T-V2: budget study and the CMS VBF/EWK ladder; a committed σ-level spine test](T-V2.md) - In a throwaway merge of #81 and #82, measure the seed spread at two budgets, then run the 5-seed ladder on the three CMS cards with their shipped param cards; on #81 itself, commit a σ-level test that the no-spine defect fails.
* [T-V3: a banked no-pT-cut EWK ℓℓjj row, and the MLM re-gates](T-V3.md) - Prepare the M3 banking of p p > e+ e- j j QCD=0 with ptj = ptl = 0 (cards, manifest row, driver support, the σ gate awaiting its bank, a smoke-sized cost estimate); re-gate the two MLM rows T-F2's maps changed.

## Session Report

* [T-F1 report: the spine is built without a pT cut, on a pole floor from a 10⁴ GeV² default scale](T-F1-report.md) - The pole floor and the support bound are now separate. The bound comes only from Cuts::spacelike_floor. The floor is always on, from the fiducial scale or from DEFAULT_POLE_SCALE = 10⁴ GeV², a value chosen by measured variance. The spine is built for every final state. Walk/density agreement holds on every peripheral diagram with no scale. σ matches flat RAMBO on a converged leptonic process. Seven banked rows move, all within their gates.
* [T-F2 report: the γγ → ℓℓ corner was the flat draw between rungs; a flat/1/ŝ remainder mixture and a 10³ GeV² pole scale](T-F2-report.md) - DY's 1547× event is drawn by the γγ ladder channel itself. The weight comes from the flat draw of the invariants between rungs (1/ŝ there) and a lepton line 0.66 GeV² off shell under the 10 GeV² floor. Those remainders are now drawn from an even flat/1/ŝ mixture, and the default pole scale is 10³ GeV². On DY at R1 the largest w/w_max falls from 13–1547 to 6–18. Over 12 seeds the seed spread falls 2–3× and the paired R1 → R4 climb from +0.54 ± 0.27 to +0.32 ± 0.12 pb: smaller, not stopped. Bias checks hold, spine_sigma still fails under M1, and 15 banked rows move and pass their re-gates.
* [T-V1 report: artifact version 15 with a channel-map digest; the CMS cards' σ is regulated by the 2 GeV factorisation floor](T-V1-report.md) - FORMAT_VERSION is 15. The artifact banks a SHA-256 over every channel's map_key, which generate checks on both paths. M1 fails the walk/density test at its first diagram. The CMS VBF cards' σ is finite. MadGraph's reweight.f, mirrored in vibegraph, zero-weights any point whose dynamical μF falls below 2 GeV, and that cuts the softest jet at pT = 2 GeV whatever ptj is. With a fixed scale the region opens and σ triples.
* [T-V2 report: the CMS VBF/EWK σ has not converged at affordable budgets; a banked σ-level spine gate](T-V2-report.md) - At about 1.1 ms a point, a 10-hour campaign reaches DY MLL-50 at two nested rungs (20 and 12 seeds) and the two VBF cards at one rung (5 seeds). The typical DY seed still climbs between the rungs (paired +0.54 ± 0.27 pb), seed χ²/dof is 3.5–14, and a γγ → ℓℓ corner carries 75% of one sample's weight. The pass condition is not met. A banked 16-seed σ test on u c > e+ e- u c, calibrated on 40 seeds per arm, fails with the spine withheld.
* [T-V3 report: a planned no-pT-cut EWK e+ e- j j σ row, its gate and the M3 request; the MLM re-gates pass](T-V3-report.md) - Row pp_to_epemjj_qcd0 (p p > e+ e- j j QCD=0 QED=4 $ h, sm-no_b_mass, ptj = ptl = 0, mmjj = 4, mmll = 50) is planned: script, run card, manifest row, a `card` kind and a dry run in bank_seeded_sigma.sh, and a long-tier σ gate that prints AWAITING THE BANK. vibegraph's side at the gate budget (40000 × 12) reads 3.5804 ± 0.0159 pb over the gate's five seeds and 3.5760 ± 0.0085 over ten; between 12 and 24 iterations the mean moves +0.04% ± 0.4%. The two MLM rows T-F2's maps moved pass their σ re-gates on the merged tree.
